description: Summarizes a CycloneDX or SPDX JSON SBOM (software bill of materials) from your own build or a supplier and checks whether the basics are there: format and spec version, product name and version, how many third-party components it lists, up to 100 component names, and findings on missing fields. Limits: 2,000,000 characters, 64 nesting levels, 50,000 components; processed in memory and not stored. Does not read XML or tag-value SBOMs and does no full schema validation or licence check; advisory lookups: sbom_vulnerabilities.

sbom_json.description: The full SBOM (software bill of materials) file content as JSON text: CycloneDX JSON or SPDX 2.x JSON, for example from Syft, Trivy, cdxgen or npm sbom. Max 2,000,000 characters. It is processed in memory and not stored.

name: sbom_summarize
title: Summarize an SBOM
